PM Modi Urges Chennai Students to Innovate and Spread Tamil Culture Globally

Prime Minister Narendra Modi, addressing students at the golden jubilee celebrations of Jaigopal Garodia Hindu Vidyalaya Matriculation Higher Secondary School in Chennai, urged them to think big and develop solutions for global challenges. He encouraged the students to carry Tamil culture with them wherever they go, stating that the world looks to them for solutions. Modi also referred to himself as the representative of Kashi, his Lok Sabha constituency.
